title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holds 65,206 dollars at US close, up 0.6 percent on the day as fear grips the tape at a 30 reading. Volume and market cap data remain unreported. Hashrate sits steady at 897 exahashes while the mempool backs up to 73,000 transactions with fees as low as one sat per vbyte. 

Key takeaway: price action stays defensive above 65k despite the sentiment chill, showing miner resilience over trader nerves.
